title: The cloud deployment flow and quality gates

videos.script: Lesson 12 checked a change by hand. This lesson makes a machine do it, every time, in the same order. {{road}} Picture the deployment flow as a road. Format, validate, scan and plan. Then a person reviews. Then a role applies. {{stages}} The cheap checks go first, so a bad change fails in seconds. {{gate}} You will write that road as one script, and watch it stop a public bucket policy before anybody plans it. {{warn}} Then the harder question: which findings block, and which only warn. {{around}} There is also a road around the road. Anyone whose own key can write to the account skips every stage. {{roles}} So the last part is about keys. The pipeline gets two roles, one to plan and one to apply, and no stored key at all. {{end}}
